Which of the following transactions correctly illustrates the doctrine of substantial performance?
Option A: Blair ordered a dozen blue chairs from Kyle but Kyle delivered a dozen red chairs.
Option B: Leslie painted an entire room but failed to put the electrical outlet covers back on.
Option C: A contract required hair styling to be done to Toby's satisfaction but Toby was in good faith dissatisfied with the completed result.
Option D: A dentist competently completed the extraction of Lee's tooth but mistakenly pulled the wrong one.
